title: John Harbaugh cites 'rules of engagement' after multiple players ejected following brawl in Giants-Dolphins joint practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh cites 'rules of engagement' after multiple players ejected following brawl in Giants-Dolphins joint practice
sources.description: Before Thursday's joint practice, Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley told reporters that he'd told his players that 'fighting's not tough.' Unfortunately, that message didn't fully take hold.
